chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Ibrahim ibn Natana (may God be pleased with him) narrated to us. He said: Ali ibn Ibrahim ibn Hashim narrated to us, from his father, from al-Rayyan ibn al-Salt, who said: I heard Abu al-Hasan Ali ibn Musa al-Rida (peace be upon him) say:

Whoever says seventy times every day in Sha'ban, "I seek the forgiveness of God and I ask Him for repentance," God will record for him a dissociation from the Fire, a permit over the Path, and will grant him the Abode of Permanence.

key_terms.أستغفر الله: Istighfar — seeking God's forgiveness, a fundamental act of worship
key_terms.التوبة: Tawbah — repentance, turning back to God
key_terms.الصراط: al-Sirat — the bridge over Hellfire that all must cross on the Day of Judgment
key_terms.دار القرار: Dar al-Qarar — the Abode of Permanence, a Quranic designation for Paradise
key_terms.شعبان: Sha'ban — the eighth month of the Islamic calendar, preceding Ramadan

ai.seo_question: What supplication did Imam al-Rida recommend for the month of Sha'ban?
ai.summary: Imam al-Rida (peace be upon him) recommended a specific daily practice for the month of Sha'ban: reciting istighfar (seeking God's forgiveness) and asking for repentance seventy times each day. This practice was taught in the context of preparing for the holy month of Ramadan, as Sha'ban is considered a spiritual preparatory month. The three rewards mentioned — immunity from Hellfire, safe passage over the Sirat bridge on the Day of Judgment, and entry into Paradise — represent the comprehensive salvation that comes from sincere repentance.

en.bilal-muhammad: Al-Husayn b. Ibrahim b. Natana (ra) narrated to us. He said: `Ali b. Ibrahim b. Hashim narrated to us from his father from al-Rayyan b. al-Salt. He said: I heard Aba’l Hasan `Ali b. Musa al-Rida (as) say:

Whoever says “I seek the forgiveness of Allah and I ask him to pardon me (istaghfirallah wa as’alahul tawba)” seventy times a day in Sha`ban, Allah will record a dissociation for him from the Fire, a permit upon the Path; and He will grant him the Resolute Abode.
